PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Planning Commissioners will attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
• Thursday, September 16 @ NOON - written correspondence is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org. If you require a physical letter, it may be mailed to or dropped off at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274.Correspondence received by this deadline will be posted online with the staff report.
• Tuesday, September 21 @ NOON - correspondence received by this time will be forwarded to the board and posted online as late correspondence. Correspondence received after this deadline will be forwarded to the committee at the start of the meeting.
• Tuesday, September 21 @ NOON - if you wish to present any visual aids such as a PowerPoint or photos during your public comment period, a PDF is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org.
• Tuesday, September 21 @ 6:30 p.m. - if you wish to speak during the meeting, you must email PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org with (1) your name, (2) the project address on which you'd like to speak, and (3) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
• As soon as possible - To invite Commissioners and/or staff to view impacts from your home, submit a request in writing to appointments@PVEstates.org.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. You will be muted upon entry. The host will unmute you when it is your turn to speak. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
The City thanks you for your patience and understanding as we do our best to carry on the public process given current circumstances.

   Speakers: None

  encroachments within the City Right-of-Way located at 3317 Via La Selva. Lot 5, Block 6100,
  Tract 6883. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title

  Applicant/Owner: Diane & Sven Nystrom
  Speakers: None

  Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard

OLD BUSINESS

3.  M-1483-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1260); Neighborhood Compatibility for additions
  to a single-family residence located at 4016 Via Nivel. Lot 5, Block 6319, Tract 7143. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15301.

  Applicant: Russ Barto, 3 Malaga Cove Plaza #202, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner: Gregg & Karen Hall
  Speakers: None

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional condition: 1. Provide planting at 118.5’ in elevation relative
  to the plans adjacent to the window seat.

4.  NC-1704-21, G-1653-21, & M-1457-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1240);
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, & Miscellaneous applications for a new single-family
  residence located at 1616 Paseo Del Mar. Lot 5 and Part of 6, Block 1270, Tract 7140. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant: Luis De Moraes, 116 South Catalina Ave Suite 102, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Kazem & Jenan Baker
  Speakers: Marryl Cahill, Anthony Stearns, Carin Stearns, Kimberly Stoneman, TJ Green on behalf
  of Marsha Green, Erica Stroh

  Action: Nendick moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional conditions: 1. There shall be no air conditioning unit within
  the rear setback; 2. There shall be no ministerial approval for any increase to building envelope or
  structure on the lot; 3. No water features in the front or side yard setback shall be deeper than 17”; 4.
  The existing hedge between 1612 Paseo Del Mar and 1616 Paseo Del Mar within the side yard setback
  is to be maintained at no higher than 4’ above proposed grade from the property line to the proposed

Planning Commission Actions  Page 2 of 4
October 19, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   side wall/gate; 5. A hedge or fence between 1616 Paseo Del Mar and 1620 Paseo Del Mar shall be
  maintained at a maximum elevation of 109’ from the face of the side yard gate toward Paseo Del Mar
  for a distance of 20’; 6. Remaining vegetation in the side yard between 1616 Paseo Del Mar and 1620
  Paseo Del Mar shall be a maximum height of 8’ at an elevation of 112’; 7. All other vegetation on lot
  shall be no higher than the adjacent eave; 8. Professional certification of structure height is required
  prior to issuance of Certificate of Occupancy; 9. The owner shall remove the existing palm and fruit
  trees on the lot; and 10. The project’s location is directly adjacent to a Significant Ecological Area.
  Therefore, the project shall comply with Low-Impact Development requirements applicable to such
  a site.

5.  NC-1690-21/G-1648-21/M-1449-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1231); Neighborhood
  Compatibility, Grading, and Miscellaneous applications for a new single-family residence located
  at 1417 Via Coronel. Lot 14, Block 44, Tract 30905. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Christopher Valenzona & Tony Ashai, 15900 Hawthorne Blvd Unit 300, Lawndale,
  CA 90260
  Owner: Gulroop & Parminder Hansra
  Speakers: Nick Sampson, Debbie Sampson, Barbara Demarest, Patricia Johnson

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to continue the project (4-0 in favor) to the next
  regularly scheduled meeting of the Planning Commission on October 19, 2021 at 6:30 P.M.

6.  M-1467-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1247); Miscellaneous application for a structure
  exceeding 8’ in height at the existing single-family residence located at 1536 Espinosa Circle. Lot
  11, Block 1374, Tract 6889. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15301.

  Applicant: Marlene Breene, 2325 Palos Verdes Drive West, Suite #212, Palos Verdes Estates CA
  90274
  Owner: Greg & Michelle Slavett

  Continued to the October 19, 2021 meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

7.  Appointment of Brianna Rindge as Secretary of the Planning Commission

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the appointment (4-0 in favor).

8.  NC-1696-21/M-1440-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1245); Neighborhood Compatibility
  and Miscellaneous applications for additions to the existing single-family residence located at 349
  Palos Verdes Drive West. Lot 22, Block 1611, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15301.

  Applicant: Charles Belak-Berger, 521 W Rosecrans Ave, Gardena, CA 90248
  Owner: Ivo Barata
  Speakers: Ravi Sreerama

Planning Commission Actions  Page 3 of 4
October 19, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Action: Lazzaro moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional conditions: 1. The balcony shall be pulled in by 5’ from each
  side of the building; 2. The pool is to be placed at rearmost portion of the property, stepped down
  from the lower floor of the home, to be at least 6’ below the fence line; 3. Habitable floor area shall
  not exceed the maximum floor area set forth by PVEMC; 4. Any cellar, storage, or nonhabitable space
  shall not exceed 6’-2” with hard ceilings and solid floors.

  Applicant: Tomaro Architecture, 2617 N Sepulveda Blvd #100, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner: Charles & Kathleen Parks

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Wade seconded to continue the project (4-0 in favor) to the next
